mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDPC1 (QoQ growth) and INDPRO (3-month change) signal economic contraction that triggers earnings revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 QoQ growth is negative and INDPRO 3-month change is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals reduced liquidity that increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in PAYEMS signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300.0 indicates elevated inflation that prompts monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in HOUST (below 1350) and RSAFS (below 700000) signal consumer demand contraction that reduces sales expectations and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST is below 1350 and RSAFS is below 700000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO signals strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate earnings growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over 3 months.
